supported_statements: Within the tested Candidate B configuration (translation <= 3cm), translation did not improve anchored stitched vertical P95 (0.00% change).
Candidate C (joint rotation <= 3 deg, translation <= 3cm) produced only marginal anchored vertical improvement (+11.428% vs R4P3) and remained far below the 25.0% gate.
retracted_unsupported_statements: Retracted: 'NO_CONSERVATIVE_RIGID_GEOMETRY_CAN_ACHIEVE_GATE'. The experiment only tested specific parameterizations (Candidates B and C); broader claims regarding all conceivable rigid configurations are unproven.

Downgraded: 'SEAM_CAUSAL_EFFECT = DOMINANT_STRUCTURAL_MODULATOR' is downgraded to 'SUPPORTED_STRUCTURAL_MODULATOR' because seam placement improves several ROIs without being proven as the root physical cause of remaining error.
